issue_title: Indirect fixture scope can outlive a parameterized parent
issue_text: When indirect parametrization widens the scope of a fixture that depends on a parameterized parent, changing the parent parameter can finalize the child too late. Reproduce with a parent that marks its resource closed on teardown and a child that checks it is still open during its own teardown. The child should finalize first.
success_criteria: Child teardown happens before the parent resource closes, and existing fixture invalidation behavior passes.
